report.title: Click shortcut edit button is not pop a edit dialog
report.body:
### Pre-submission Checklist

- [x] I have searched the existing issues and this bug has not been reported yet
- [x] I have tested this issue on the [demo site](https://demo.usememos.com) or the latest version

### Where did you encounter this bug?

Latest stable version (self-hosted)

### Memos Version

v0.26.0

### Bug Description

Just see in this image:

![Image](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/a145f714-85e2-4b29-a476-cf26c53e9518)

### Steps to Reproduce

1. Add a item in shortcut
2. Click the menu of this item, and choose edit option
3. Pop a create dialog, Not a edit dialog

### Expected Behavior

Click edit button and then just pop a edit dialog.

### Screenshots & Additional Context

_No response_

preconditions: the app is a fresh install with no shortcuts
the shortcuts section is visible in the sidebar of the home page
steps: Click the add (+) button next to the Shortcuts section in the sidebar
In the create shortcut dialog, type a title for the shortcut
Enter a filter for the shortcut if the dialog requires one
Click the save/create button to add the shortcut
Click the menu (three dots) button of the newly created shortcut item in the sidebar
Choose the 'Edit' option from the menu
plan.expected: after choosing Edit, a dialog titled for editing a shortcut (not creating one) is visible, showing the existing shortcut's title and filter
plan.reported_actual: Choosing Edit on a shortcut's menu opens a create-shortcut dialog instead of an edit-shortcut dialog
missing: What title and filter should be used when creating the shortcut?
Where exactly is the shortcut list (sidebar, mobile menu)?
What exact text does the dialog show (title and button label)? The screenshot was not readable
assumed: the shortcut is created via the '+' button next to Shortcuts in the sidebar
assumed: a shortcut needs a title and a filter expression, and any simple values are acceptable
plan.summary: Choosing Edit from a shortcut's menu opens a create dialog instead of an edit dialog

# Click shortcut edit button is not pop a edit dialog

## Reproduce the report
Open http://localhost:15309/.

Do these in order:
1. Click the add (+) button next to the Shortcuts section in the sidebar
2. In the create shortcut dialog, type a title for the shortcut
3. Enter a filter for the shortcut if the dialog requires one
4. Click the save/create button to add the shortcut
5. Click the menu (three dots) button of the newly created shortcut item in the sidebar
6. Choose the 'Edit' option from the menu
The reporter says the correct behavior is that after choosing Edit, a dialog titled for editing a shortcut (not creating one) is visible, showing the existing shortcut's title and filter.
